# QuestWeaver

> A static, private-in-the-browser editor that converts a versioned JSON project into an FTB Quests format-13 ZIP.

## AI authoring

- Guide: https://kiradiamond.github.io/QuestWeaver/ai-guide.txt
- JSON Schema: https://kiradiamond.github.io/QuestWeaver/questweaver.schema.json
- Example project: https://kiradiamond.github.io/QuestWeaver/questweaver.example.json
- Source and documentation: https://github.com/KiraDiamond/QuestWeaver

Text-only models do not need to operate the editor. Read the guide and return a valid QuestWeaver JSON object for the human to import.
